mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 5-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates for equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS growth above 12-month average) combined with robust consumer demand (HOUST growth above 12-month average) signals a synchronized economic expansion that drives positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: In instances where both PAYEMS and HOUST are above their 12-month averages, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate by more than 0.1 percentage points signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: In low-unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE declines by more than 0.1pp, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1500 thousand units, it signals strong consumer demand for housing and a robust economy, driving positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST > 1500.0, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts over the past 3 months indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST has increased by at least 1.0% over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 5-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A synchronized increase in industrial production (supply) and housing starts (demand) signals a robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: In instances where both INDPRO and HOUST are above their 12-month averages, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production exceeds 115 (index 2017=100), it indicates strong manufacturing activity and drives positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO > 115.0, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.04.
